facts.fact: The article states that the law n° 18-07 is in force and that, since it entered into force, the authorities have multiplied implementing texts; the article's published date 2026-07-20 is used as the date.
The article states that the ANPDP adopted a deliberation on Wednesday 15 July 2026, acting as the national data protection authority.

The article states that the ANPDP adopted a deliberation on 15 July 2026 on publishing images on platforms to adapt application of law 18-07, and that in recent months it also published rules on workplace video surveillance and on appointing data protection delegates.
The article states that the ANPDP's deliberation sets consent, information and transfer rules for images and that individuals may complain to the ANPDP; it reports no sanction or count of decisions.
The article reports that the ANPDP adopted a new deliberation on 15 July 2026 and describes it as a progressive strengthening of Algeria's data protection arrangements.
